title: Liquid nitrogen made by hand at the player's station in Dheneb from the trader's own stored nitrogen ice, docked, no jump
note: 2026-11-22 15:37 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-064, block MERCURY (every trader operating at the least fuel per XP, before jump loops), P1 and P5; rule F23 (every ship crafts its own stores). Traders store 14382 nitrogen ice at the player's station in Dheneb (table holdings, storage book 2026-11-22 15:32 UTC); its best bid is 2 cr (the tool stock view=surplus) and none of it is reserved. process_nitrogen_ice (by hand, 0 cr): 4 liquid nitrogen (base 22, an input of 30 recipes: coolant loop, ice harvester II and III ...) from 5 nitrogen ice (base 15). A trader docked here trains Crafting with no jump and no fuel, in place of the jump loop (train-jumps-trader, -551 cr a ship-hour in 4 hours). The craft list asks the recipe in halving sizes (128 down to 1, as craft-armor-own-*): a size the stores cannot fill makes nothing and the next is asked. Nothing is bought or sold; the liquid nitrogen stays in the pilot's storage. Standing work; closes by itself under 100 nitrogen ice stored here. A test: three results decide (F37); max_ships 1, the traders that hold the ice here.
